text:
Sea water is denser than fresh water.
Where is the pressure on a diver greatest?
A
10m below the surface of a fresh-water lake
B
10m below the surface of the sea
C
20m below the surface of a fresh-water lake
D
20m below the surface of the sea

options.label: A
options.text: 10m below the surface of a fresh-water lake

options.label: B
options.text: 10m below the surface of the sea

options.label: C
options.text: 20m below the surface of a fresh-water lake

options.label: D
options.text: 20m below the surface of the sea
